Wurster Auth — embeddable identity field

A single embeddable component any Wurst can drop into its own UI wherever it wants a "login." Default state is a plain Meatphrase field; the lock/avatar badge on the left switches to a picker over identities already stored on this device. Confirming with a stored identity swaps the avatar for a fingerprint and hands off to the OS keystore (Touch ID, Windows Hello, or OAuth).

Behavior notes
  • Default mode is a raw Meatphrase field — works even with zero stored identities.
  • Left-hand badge toggles a picker over identities already in this device's Meat Locker.
  • Selecting an identity and confirming swaps the avatar for a fingerprint and hands off to the OS keystore (Touch ID / Windows Hello) or OAuth.
  • Ships as one embeddable component any Wurst can drop wherever it needs a "login" — a separate full identity-management dialog exists, but is optional.
